entry.en: Your passport must expire at least 6 months after the date you arrive.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe vencer al menos 6 meses después de la fecha de llegada.
entry.quote: passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive

entry.en: E-visa fees must be paid on arrival in exact cash in euros or US dollars, and change and receipts are not given.
entry.es: Las tarifas de la e-visa se pagan al llegar en efectivo exacto en euros o dólares, y no se da cambio ni recibo.
entry.quote: E-visa fees must be paid on arrival in Mauritania in exact cash in Euros or US dollars. Change and receipts are not given.

entry.en: You should print a copy of the e-visa and be ready to provide it on arrival.
entry.es: Debes imprimir una copia de la e-visa y estar listo para entregarla a la llegada.
entry.quote: You should also print a copy of the e-visa and be ready to provide a copy on arrival in country.

entry.en: You need a yellow fever vaccination certificate if you are coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Necesitas un certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si vienes de un país catalogado como de riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk

entry.en: It is illegal for Muslims and non-Muslims to import or consume alcohol and pork products in Mauritania.
entry.es: Es ilegal para musulmanes y no musulmanes importar o consumir alcohol y productos de cerdo en Mauritania.
entry.quote: It is illegal for Muslims and non-Muslims to import or consume alcohol and pork products in Mauritania.

entry.en: It is illegal to take Mauritanian currency out of the country.
entry.es: Es ilegal sacar moneda mauritana del país.
entry.quote: It is illegal to take Mauritanian currency (ougiyas) out of the country.

safety.en: FCDO advises against all travel within 25km of the Malian border in the south, including Khabou.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje a menos de 25 km de la frontera con Malí en el sur, incluida Khabou.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all travel to areas within 25km of the Malian border in the south, including Khabou.

safety.en: FCDO advises against all travel to eastern Mauritania, east of a line between Kankossa, Akhreijit, Ghallaouia, Zouerat and Fderîck.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje al este de Mauritania, al este de una línea entre Kankossa, Akhreijit, Ghallaouia, Zouerat y Fderîck.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all travel to areas east of a line drawn between but excluding the towns of Kankossa, Akhreijit, Ghallaouia, Zouerat, Fderîck and onwards west to the border with Western Sahara.

safety.en: Terrorist attacks in Mauritania cannot be ruled out.
safety.es: No se pueden descartar atentados terroristas en Mauritania.
safety.quote: Terrorist attacks in Mauritania cannot be ruled out.

safety.en: There have been thefts and robberies at knifepoint, day and night, on the unlit and isolated beaches in Nouakchott.
safety.es: Ha habido robos y asaltos a punta de cuchillo, de día y de noche, en las playas oscuras y aisladas de Nouakchott.
safety.quote: There have been thefts and robberies at knifepoint during the day and night on the unlit and isolated beaches in Nouakchott

safety.en: Unexploded landmines remain on the border with Western Sahara.
safety.es: Quedan minas terrestres sin explotar en la frontera con el Sáhara Occidental.
safety.quote: Unexploded landmines remain on the border with Western Sahara.

safety.en: Under Mauritanian law, the maximum penalty for sexual activity between men is death.
safety.es: Según la ley mauritana, la pena máxima por actividad sexual entre hombres es la muerte.
safety.quote: Under Mauritanian law, the maximum penalty for sexual activity between men is death.

health.en: Medical facilities are extremely limited, particularly outside Nouakchott and Nouadhibou, where poor communications make emergencies very difficult to handle.
health.es: Las instalaciones médicas son extremadamente limitadas, sobre todo fuera de Nouakchott y Nouadhibou, donde la falta de comunicaciones dificulta mucho las emergencias.
health.quote: Medical facilities are extremely limited in Mauritania, particularly outside Nouakchott and Nouadhibou, where lack of communications makes dealing with an emergency very difficult.

health.en: Many medicines may be fake or hard to find, so carry enough prescription medication for your stay.
health.es: Muchos medicamentos pueden ser falsos o difíciles de encontrar, así que lleva suficiente medicación recetada para tu estancia.
health.quote: Many medicines may be fake or hard to find in Mauritania. Carry enough of your prescription medication for your stay.

health.en: Clinics in Nouakchott and Nouadhibou charge for care, sometimes in euros or US dollars, and may not accept foreign insurance cards.
health.es: Las clínicas de Nouakchott y Nouadhibou cobran la atención, a veces en euros o dólares, y pueden no aceptar tarjetas de seguro extranjeras.
health.quote: Clinics in Nouakchott and Nouadhibou charge for medical care (sometimes in euros or US dollars) and may not accept foreign insurance cards.

health.en: For the majority of Westerners, local water anywhere in the country, including Nouakchott, is not safe to drink.
health.es: Para la mayoría de los occidentales, el agua local en cualquier parte del país, incluida Nouakchott, no es segura para beber.
health.quote: For the majority of Westerners, the local water in any part of the country (including Nouakchott) is not safe to drink.

health.en: Malaria is endemic in the south of the country, and visitors should always use a mosquito net there.
health.es: La malaria es endémica en el sur del país, y los visitantes deben usar siempre mosquitero allí.
health.quote: Malaria is endemic in the southern part of the country, and visitors should always use a mosquito net there.

health.en: The Sahara is very dry and you may become dehydrated quite easily without being aware of it.
health.es: El Sahara es muy seco y puedes deshidratarte con facilidad sin darte cuenta.
health.quote: The Sahara is a very dry climate. You may become dehydrated quite easily, and not be aware of it.

help.en: Emergency numbers are 101 for ambulance, 118 for fire and 117 for police, though authorities may not answer.
help.es: Los números de emergencia son 101 (ambulancia), 118 (bomberos) y 117 (policía), aunque las autoridades pueden no contestar.
help.quote: Ambulance: 101 Fire: 118 Police: 117 The Mauritania authorities may not answer calls to these numbers.

help.en: Report crime to the police by dialling 117 or visiting a police station.
help.es: Denuncia los delitos a la policía llamando al 117 o acudiendo a una comisaría.
help.quote: Report crime to the police by dialling 117 or visiting a police station.

getting_in.en: Nouakchott-Oumtounsy International Airport (NKC) is the base of Mauritania Airlines, which flies from Conakry, Bamako, Dakar, Casablanca, Abidjan, Nema, Zouerat and Nouadhibou.
getting_in.es: El Aeropuerto Internacional Nouakchott-Oumtounsy (NKC) es la base de Mauritania Airlines, que vuela desde Conakry, Bamako, Dakar, Casablanca, Abiyán, Nema, Zouerat y Nouadhibou.
getting_in.quote: Nouakchott–Oumtounsy International Airport (NKC IATA) is the base for Mauritania Airlines, which flies from Conakry, Bamako, Dakar, Casablanca, Abidjan, Nema, Zouerat, and Nouadhibou.

getting_in.en: Nouadhibou International Airport (NDB) receives flights from Gran Canaria with Mauritania Airlines.
getting_in.es: El Aeropuerto Internacional de Nouadhibou (NDB) recibe vuelos desde Gran Canaria con Mauritania Airlines.
getting_in.quote: Nouadhibou International Airport (NDB IATA) receives flights from Gran Canaria with Mauritania Airlines.

getting_in.en: Mauritania has open road borders with Western Sahara, Mali and Senegal, but the first two are described as extremely dangerous.
getting_in.es: Mauritania tiene fronteras terrestres abiertas con el Sáhara Occidental, Malí y Senegal, pero las dos primeras se describen como extremadamente peligrosas.
getting_in.quote: Mauritania has open road borders with Western Sahara, Mali and Senegal. These borders are open to crossing by private motor vehicle or bicycle but the first two are extremely dangerous.

getting_in.en: At the Western Sahara crossing, do not leave the well-worn pistes between the two border posts because the area is a mine field.
getting_in.es: En el cruce con el Sáhara Occidental, no hay que salir de las pistas marcadas entre los dos puestos fronterizos porque la zona es un campo minado.
getting_in.quote: care should be taken not to leave the well-worn pistes between the two border posts, because the area is a mine field.

getting_in.en: Transit visas valid for 3 days can no longer be bought at the border, although this may change.
getting_in.es: Las visas de tránsito de 3 días ya no se pueden comprar en la frontera, aunque esto podría cambiar.
getting_in.quote: Transit visas, valid for 3 days, can no longer be bought at the border, although this may change.

getting_in.en: Crossing the border into Mauritania can be time-consuming, and officials may ask for payments before letting you cross.
getting_in.es: Cruzar la frontera hacia Mauritania puede llevar mucho tiempo, y los funcionarios pueden pedir pagos antes de dejarte pasar.
getting_in.quote: Crossing the border into Mauritania can be time-consuming, and officials may ask for payments before they allow you to cross.

getting_around.en: To get through the many checkpoints on major roads, the text advises carrying 30-40 copies of a "fiche" with your passport and vehicle information.
getting_around.es: Para pasar los numerosos controles en las carreteras principales, el texto aconseja llevar 30-40 copias de una "fiche" con los datos de tu pasaporte y vehículo.
getting_around.quote: you should carry 30–40 copies of a "fiche" (a data sheet containing your passport and vehicle information) to hand over to the officers.

getting_around.en: If you must get around a city, only use trusted, pre-arranged taxis.
getting_around.es: Si debes desplazarte por una ciudad, usa solo taxis de confianza y reservados con antelación.
getting_around.quote: If you must get around a city, only use trusted, pre-arranged taxis.

getting_around.en: Ride-hailing is available in Mauritania, for example Classride, which works in Nouakchott.
getting_around.es: Hay transporte por aplicación en Mauritania, por ejemplo Classride, que funciona en Nouakchott.
getting_around.quote: Ride-hailing is available in Mauritania. Classride. A Mauritanian ridesharing company. Works in Nouakchott.

getting_around.en: As of 2023 there is only one train line, the Iron Ore Train, between Nouadhibou, Choum and Zouerat.
getting_around.es: En 2023 solo hay una línea de tren, el Tren del Mineral de Hierro, entre Nouadhibou, Choum y Zouerat.
getting_around.quote: As of 2023, there's only one train line linking the following cities: the Iron Ore Train, between Nouadhibou, Choum and Zouerat.

getting_around.en: The train departs daily from Nouadhibou at around 15:00 and arrives in Choum at around 02:00 the next morning.
getting_around.es: El tren sale a diario de Nouadhibou hacia las 15:00 y llega a Choum hacia las 02:00 de la madrugada siguiente.
getting_around.quote: The train departs daily from Nouadhibou at around 15:00 and arrives in Choum (for Atar) at around 02:00 the next morning.

getting_around.en: Overland travel is difficult, and you should use a 4-wheel-drive vehicle and avoid travelling at night.
getting_around.es: Viajar por tierra es difícil, y se debe usar un vehículo 4x4 y evitar viajar de noche.
getting_around.quote: Overland travel is difficult, and you should use a 4-wheel-drive vehicle and avoid travelling at night.

money.en: The currency is the Mauritanian ouguiya (UM, ISO code MRU).
money.es: La moneda es la uguya mauritana (UM, código ISO MRU).
money.quote: The country's currency is the Mauritanian ouguiya (pron. oo-gee-ya), denoted by the symbol "UM"

money.en: Mauritania is poorly connected to the international banking system, but ATMs in Nouakchott and Nouadhibou accept international Visa cards at banks such as BNP and Attijari.
money.es: Mauritania está mal conectada al sistema bancario internacional, pero los cajeros de Nouakchott y Nouadhibou aceptan tarjetas Visa en bancos como BNP y Attijari.
money.quote: Mauritania is poorly connected to the international banking system. ATMs in Nouakchott and Nouadhibou now accept international Visa cards at banks such as BNP, Attijari.

money.en: Cash may not be available at all ATMs, especially outside the main cities, so do not rely solely on ATMs.
money.es: Puede que no haya efectivo en todos los cajeros, sobre todo fuera de las ciudades principales, así que no dependas solo de ellos.
money.quote: Cash may not be available at all ATMs, especially in regional Mauritania, so don't solely rely on ATMs for currency.

money.en: Mauritania is mainly cash-based, and a few hotels in Nouakchott and Nouadhibou accept credit cards, some only Visa.
money.es: Mauritania es una sociedad principalmente de efectivo, y pocos hoteles de Nouakchott y Nouadhibou aceptan tarjetas, algunos solo Visa.
money.quote: Mauritania is mainly a cash-based society. A few hotels in Nouakchott and Nouadhibou accept credit cards – some hotels only accept Visa cards.

money.en: It is easy to change euros, US dollars and CFA francs in Nouakchott.
money.es: Es fácil cambiar euros, dólares y francos CFA en Nouakchott.
money.quote: It is easy to change euros, US dollars and CFA francs in Nouakchott.

money.en: The text advises bargaining for everything, saying the starting price is sometimes three times the actual price.
money.es: El texto aconseja regatear todo, indicando que a veces el precio inicial es el triple del precio real.
money.quote: When buying anything in Mauritania, be sure to bargain. Sometimes the starting price will be three times the actual price.

etiquette.en: The text advises learning 'Salaam alaykum' and using it when greeting people.
etiquette.es: El texto aconseja aprender 'Salaam alaykum' y usarlo al saludar.
etiquette.quote: Learn Salaam alaykum and use it when greeting people.

etiquette.en: Eat with your right hand, especially outside Nouakchott where cutlery may not be offered.
etiquette.es: Come con la mano derecha, sobre todo fuera de Nouakchott, donde puede que no ofrezcan cubiertos.
etiquette.quote: Be careful to eat with your right hand, especially outside of Nouakchott where you may not be offered cutlery.

etiquette.en: Dress modestly away from the beach: women should cover their shoulders and avoid short skirts, and men should avoid sleeveless tops or shorts.
etiquette.es: Viste con modestia fuera de la playa: las mujeres deben cubrirse los hombros y evitar faldas cortas, y los hombres evitar camisetas sin mangas o pantalones cortos.
etiquette.quote: You should dress modestly when not on the beach. Women should cover their shoulders and not wear short skirts. Men should not wear sleeveless tops or shorts.

etiquette.en: It is unwise to speak badly of Islam, hand out non-Islamic religious literature or encourage religious debates.
etiquette.es: No es prudente hablar mal del islam, repartir literatura religiosa no islámica ni fomentar debates religiosos.
etiquette.quote: It is unwise to speak badly of Islam, hand out non-Islamic religious literature, or encourage people to participate in religious debates.

etiquette.en: During Ramadan, do not eat, drink, smoke or chew gum in public in the daytime, including in your car.
etiquette.es: Durante el Ramadán, no comas, bebas, fumes ni mastiques chicle en público de día, incluso en tu coche.
etiquette.quote: Ramadan is a holy month for Muslims. The dates vary by year and country. During this time, do not eat, drink, smoke or chew gum in public in the daytime, including in your car.

etiquette.en: Do not photograph or film government and military sites or members of the security forces.
etiquette.es: No fotografíes ni filmes sitios gubernamentales y militares ni a miembros de las fuerzas de seguridad.
etiquette.quote: Do not photograph or film government and military sites or members of the security forces.

connectivity.en: There are three GSM operators, Mattel, Mauritel Mobiles and Chinguitel, with prepaid plans and 3G/4G with good data speeds.
connectivity.es: Hay tres operadores GSM, Mattel, Mauritel Mobiles y Chinguitel, con planes prepago y 3G/4G con buenas velocidades de datos.
connectivity.quote: There are three operators of GSM networks: Mattel (excellent English website), Mauritel Mobiles and Chinguitel . Prepaid plans are available for three of them. 3G/4G is available and data speeds are good.

connectivity.en: For desert tours where no GSM network is available, satellite phones are a good solution.
connectivity.es: Para excursiones al desierto sin red GSM, los teléfonos satelitales son una buena solución.
connectivity.quote: For tours into the desert where no GSM-Network is available satellite phones are a good solution.

connectivity.en: Internet cafés with DSL can be found in Nouakchott and Nouadhibou for 200-300 UM/hour.
connectivity.es: Hay cibercafés con DSL en Nouakchott y Nouadhibou por 200-300 UM la hora.
connectivity.quote: Internet cafés with DSL internet can be found in Nouakchott and Nouadhibou for 200-300 UM/hour.
